intro.en: In this lesson we read a text about protecting the environment. It says what the environment is, why we must look after it, and three causes of pollution.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum mahaul ki hifazat par ek matn parhenge. Is mein bataya gaya hai ke mahaul kya hai, uski dekh-bhaal kyun zaroori hai aur aaloodgi ke teen asbab kya hain.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ في هذا الدَّرْسِ نَصّاً عَنْ حِمايَةِ البيئَةِ: ما البيئَةُ، وَلِماذا يَجِبُ أَنْ نَحْفَظَها، وَما أَسْبابُ التَّلَوُّثِ الثَّلاثَةُ.

dialogue.ar: اِزْدادَ الاهْتِمامُ في العَقْدِ الأَخيرِ بِمَوْضوعِ حِمايَةِ البيئَةِ مِنَ التَّلَوُّث.
dialogue.tr: izdāda l-ihtimāmu fī l-ʿaqdi l-akhīri bi-mawḍūʿi ḥimāyati l-bīʾati mina t-talawwuth
dialogue.en: In the last decade, interest in protecting the environment from pollution has increased.
dialogue.ur: Pichhle das saal mein mahaul ko aaloodgi se bachane ki taraf tawajjoh barh gayi.

dialogue.ar: البيئَةُ هِيَ الأَرْضُ الَّتي نَحْيا عَلَيْها، وَنَأْكُلُ مِنْ خَيْراتِها.
dialogue.tr: al-bīʾatu hiya l-arḍu llatī naḥyā ʿalayhā, wa naʾkulu min khayrātihā
dialogue.en: The environment is the earth we live on and eat from its good things.
dialogue.ur: Mahaul woh zameen hai jis par hum jeete hain aur jis ki nematon mein se khate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ البَحْرُ الَّذي تَجْري فيهِ السُّفُنُ، وَنَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا.
dialogue.tr: wa hiya l-baḥru lladhī tajrī fīhi s-sufunu, wa naʾkulu minhu laḥman ṭariyyan
dialogue.en: It is the sea in which ships sail and from which we eat fresh meat (fish).
dialogue.ur: Aur woh samundar hai jis mein kashtiyan chalti hain aur jis se hum taza gosht khate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ الهَواءُ الَّذي نَتَنَفَّسُهُ، وَالشَّمْسُ الَّتي تُمِدُّنا بِالضِّياءِ وَالطّاقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa hiya l-hawāʾu lladhī natanaffasuhu, wa sh-shamsu llatī tumiddunā bi-ḍ-ḍiyāʾi wa ṭ-ṭāqa
dialogue.en: It is the air we breathe, and the sun that gives us light and energy.
dialogue.ur: Aur woh hawa hai jis mein hum saans lete hain aur woh sooraj hai jo hamein roshni aur taaqat deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ مَجْموعَةُ النَّباتاتِ وَالحَيَواناتِ، وَهِيَ الجِبالُ الَّتي تُثَبِّتُ الأَرْض.
dialogue.tr: wa hiya majmūʿatu n-nabātāti wal-ḥayawānāt, wa hiya l-jibālu llatī tuthabbitu l-arḍ
dialogue.en: It is the plants and animals, and the mountains that keep the earth steady.
dialogue.ur: Aur woh paudhe aur janwar hain, aur woh pahaar hain jo zameen ko qaim rakhte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَكُلُّ ما خَلَقَهُ اللهُ عَلى الأَرْضِ وُجِدَ كامِلًا مُتَكامِلًا.
dialogue.tr: wa kullu mā khalaqahu llāhu ʿala l-arḍi wujida kāmilan mutakāmilan
dialogue.en: Everything Allah created on earth was made complete and in harmony.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne zameen par jo kuch banaya woh mukammal aur ek doosre se jura hua paida hua.

dialogue.ar: لا يَجوزُ لِلإِنْسانِ أَنْ يُفْسِدَ الأَرْضَ بِما يُخِلُّ بِذَلِكَ التَّوازُن.
dialogue.tr: lā yajūzu lil-insāni an yufsida l-arḍa bi-mā yukhillu bi-dhālika t-tawāzun
dialogue.en: It is not allowed for a person to spoil the earth in a way that upsets this balance.
dialogue.ur: Insan ke liye jaiz nahin ke woh zameen mein aisa bigaad kare jo is tawazun ko bigaade.

dialogue.ar: حِمايَةُ البيئَةِ واجِبٌ شَخْصِيٌّ، وَمَسْؤولِيَّةُ كُلِّ إِنْسان.
dialogue.tr: ḥimāyatu l-bīʾati wājibun shakhṣiyyun, wa masʾūliyyatu kulli insān
dialogue.en: Protecting the environment is a personal duty and every person's responsibility.
dialogue.ur: Mahaul ki hifazat zaati farz aur har insan ki zimmedari hai.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ ثَلاثَةُ عَوامِلَ تُؤَدّي إِلى تَلَوُّثِ البيئَةِ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka thalāthatu ʿawāmila tuʾaddī ilā talawwuthi l-bīʾa
dialogue.en: There are three factors that lead to pollution of the environment.
dialogue.ur: Mahaul ki aaloodgi ke teen asbab hain.

dialogue.ar: الأَوَّلُ: الثَّوْرَةُ الصِّناعِيَّةُ بِضَخامَتِها، وَمَعَها تَلَوُّثُ البيئَةِ وَاسْتِنْزافُ مَوارِدِها.
dialogue.tr: al-awwalu: ath-thawratu ṣ-ṣināʿiyyatu bi-ḍakhāmatihā, wa maʿahā talawwuthu l-bīʾati wastinzāfu mawāridihā
dialogue.en: First: the huge industrial revolution, and with it pollution and the draining of resources.
dialogue.ur: Pehla: sanati inqilab apni azeem shaan ke saath, aur uske saath aaloodgi aur wasail ka khatam hona.

dialogue.ar: الثّاني: الاسْتِعْمالُ الخاطِئُ لِبَعْضِ المَوادِّ في الزِّراعَةِ كَالأَسْمِدَةِ وَالمُبيداتِ الحَشَرِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: ath-thānī: al-istiʿmālu l-khāṭiʾu li-baʿḍi l-mawādd fiz-zirāʿati ka-l-asmidati wal-mubīdāti l-ḥashariyya
dialogue.en: Second: the wrong use of some materials in farming, like fertilizers and insect killers.
dialogue.ur: Doosra: kheti mein kuch cheezon ka ghalat istemal, jaise khaad aur keeray maar dawaiyan.

dialogue.ar: الثّالِثُ: الحُروبُ، حَيْثُ الأَضْرارُ الفادِحَةُ الَّتي تُلْحِقُها بِالبيئَة.
dialogue.tr: ath-thālithu: al-ḥurūbu, ḥaythu l-aḍrāru l-fādiḥatu llatī tulḥiquhā bil-bīʾa
dialogue.en: Third: wars, because of the terrible harm they cause the environment.
dialogue.ur: Teesra: jangein, kyunke woh mahaul ko bahut bhari nuqsan pahunchati hain.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ يُمْكِنُ الحَدُّ مِنْ تَلَوُّثِ البيئَةِ دونَ أَنْ تَتَوَقَّفَ عَجَلَةُ النُّمُوِّ الاقْتِصادِيِّ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa yumkinu l-ḥaddu min talawwuthi l-bīʾati dūna an tatawaqqafa ʿajalatu n-numuwwi l-iqtiṣādī?
dialogue.en: How can pollution be limited without stopping the wheel of economic growth?
dialogue.ur: Maashi taraqqi ka pahiya roke baghair aaloodgi ko kaise kam kiya ja sakta hai?

q.en: Which is NOT one of the three causes of pollution in the text?
q.ur: Matn mein aaloodgi ke teen asbab mein se kaun sa sabab nahin hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ هذِهِ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَسْبابِ التَّلَوُّثِ الثَّلاثَةِ في النَّصِّ؟

q.en: According to the text, protecting the environment is the duty of:
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq mahaul ki hifazat kis ki zimmedari hai?
q.ar: حِمايَةُ البيئَةِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ واجِبٌ عَلى:

q.ur: «Pahaar» ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني أَرْضاً عالِيَةً تَرْتَفِعُ فَوْقَ السَّهْلِ؟

q.en: The text says the sea is where:
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq samundar mein kya hota hai?
q.ar: يَقولُ النَّصُّ إِنَّ البَحْرَ هُوَ المَكانُ الَّذي:

options: we breathe / hum saans lete hain

title.en: Grammar (A): Nouns in the raised case (marfūʿāt)

intro.en: Some nouns take the 'raised' ending (ḍamma ـُ). They are: the subject-starter (mubtadaʾ), the predicate (khabar), the doer (fāʿil), the stand-in doer (nāʾib al-fāʿil), the name of كان and its sisters, the predicate of إنّ, and a follower of a raised noun. Example: «الشّاهِدانِ صادِقانِ» - 'the two witnesses are truthful'.
intro.ur: Kuch ismon par raf' (ضمّہ) aata hai: mubtada, khabar, faail, naib-e-faail, ism-e-kaana, khabar-e-inna aur marfu' ka tabe'. Misaal: «الشّاهِدانِ صادِقانِ» - 'dono gawah sachche hain'. Is sabaq mein hum inki misalein dekhte hain.
intro.ar: بَعْضُ الأَسْماءِ تَأْتي مَرْفوعَةً بِالضَّمَّةِ: المُبْتَدَأُ، وَالخَبَرُ، وَالفاعِلُ، وَنائِبُ الفاعِلِ، وَاسْمُ كانَ وَأَخَواتِها، وَخَبَرُ إِنَّ، وَالتّابِعُ لِمَرْفوعٍ. مِثالٌ: «الشّاهِدانِ صادِقانِ».

dialogue.ar: اللهُ لَطيفٌ بِعِبادِهِ.
dialogue.tr: allāhu laṭīfun bi-ʿibādihi
dialogue.en: Allah is kind to His servants. (Allah = subject-starter, laṭīf = predicate)
dialogue.ur: Allah apne bandon par meherban hai. (Allah = mubtada, lateef = khabar)

dialogue.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللهُ بِبَدْرٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa laqad naṣarakumu llāhu bi-badr
dialogue.en: And Allah helped you at Badr. (Allah = doer)
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah ne Badr mein tumhari madad ki. (Allah = faail)

dialogue.ar: غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ.
dialogue.tr: ghulibati r-rūm
dialogue.en: The Romans were defeated. (ar-Rūm = stand-in doer)
dialogue.ur: Rum ko shikast di gayi. (ar-Rum = naib-e-faail)

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ اللهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ.
dialogue.tr: inna llāha ghafūrun raḥīm
dialogue.en: Indeed Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. (ghafūr = predicate of inna)
dialogue.ur: Beshak Allah bakhshne wala meherban hai. (ghafoor = khabar-e-inna)

dialogue.ar: أَمْسى الطّالِبانِ مُجْتَهِدَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: amsā ṭ-ṭālibāni mujtahidayn
dialogue.en: The two students became hard-working. (ṭālibān = name of amsā)
dialogue.ur: Dono talib-ilm mehnati ho gaye. (talibaan = ism-e-amsa)

dialogue.ar: جاءَ رَجُلٌ كَريمٌ.
dialogue.tr: jāʾa rajulun karīm
dialogue.en: A generous man came. (karīm describes the raised noun)
dialogue.ur: Ek sakhi aadmi aaya. (kareem = marfu' ki sifat)

dialogue.ar: الإِسْلامُ دينُ الحَقِّ.
dialogue.tr: al-islāmu dīnu l-ḥaqq
dialogue.en: Islam is the religion of truth.
dialogue.ur: Islam sachchai ka deen hai.

dialogue.ar: دَعا الإِسْلامُ إِلى العَدْلِ.
dialogue.tr: daʿā l-islāmu ilā l-ʿadl
dialogue.en: Islam called to justice.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne insaaf ki taraf bulaya.

options: It describes the man / Aadmi ki sifat
The doer of the action / Kaam karne wala
Islam is the religion of truth

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Miyan biwi ke ikhtilafat

intro.en: This lesson has two listening parts: the causes of marital disagreements and their effects. Listen to the audio, then mark each statement true or false and choose the right answers. Here we learn the key words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do sunne ke hisse hain: miyan biwi ke ikhtilafat ke asbab aur unke asraat. Audio sunein, phir har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat kahein aur sahi jawab chunein. Yahan hum aham alfaz seekhte hain.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ: أَسْبابُ الخِلافاتِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ وَآثارُها. اسْتَمِعْ ثُمَّ احْكُمْ عَلى كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ، وَاخْتَرِ الإِجاباتِ الصَّحيحَةَ. نَتَعَلَّمُ هُنا الكَلِماتِ الأَساسِيَّةَ.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَسْبابِ الخِلافاتِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ سوءُ الاخْتِيار.
dialogue.tr: min asbābi l-khilāfāti z-zawjiyyati sūʾu l-ikhtiyār
dialogue.en: One cause of marital disagreements is a bad choice (of spouse).
dialogue.ur: Miyan biwi ke ikhtilafat ka ek sabab ghalat intekhab hai.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَسْبابِ المُشْكِلاتِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ عَدَمُ التَّمَسُّكِ بِالآدابِ الشَّرْعِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: min asbābi l-mushkilāti z-zawjiyyati ʿadamu t-tamassuki bil-ādābi sh-sharʿiyya
dialogue.en: One cause is not holding to the manners of the Sharia.
dialogue.ur: Ek sabab sharai adaab par qaim na rehna hai.

dialogue.ar: أَصْبَحَتِ المُهورُ اليَوْمَ غالِيَةً جِدًّا.
dialogue.tr: aṣbaḥati l-muhūru l-yawma ghāliyatan jiddan
dialogue.en: Dowries today have become very expensive.
dialogue.ur: Aaj kal mehr bahut mehnge ho gaye hain.

dialogue.ar: لِلاخْتِلافِ بَيْنَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ آثارٌ سَلْبِيَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: lil-ikhtilāfi bayna z-zawjayni āthārun salbiyya
dialogue.en: Disagreement between spouses has negative effects.
dialogue.ur: Miyan biwi ke ikhtilaf ke manfi asraat hote hain.

dialogue.ar: قَطيعَةُ الأَرْحامِ مُحَرَّمَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: qaṭīʿatu l-arḥāmi muḥarramah
dialogue.en: Cutting off family ties is forbidden.
dialogue.ur: Rishte-dari todna haram hai.

dialogue.ar: المُخالَفَةُ قَدْ تَكونُ سَبَبًا في المَزيدِ مِنَ المُخالَفاتِ.
dialogue.tr: al-mukhālafatu qad takūnu sababan fil-mazīdi mina l-mukhālafāt
dialogue.en: One wrong may be a cause of more wrongs.
dialogue.ur: Ek gunah mazeed gunahon ka sabab ban sakta hai.

options_ar: مَنْ نُحِبُّهُ وَنَثِقُ بِهِ مِنَ الرِّفاقِ

intro.en: Here we practise reciting poetry. The poem is Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr's famous ode «بانَتْ سُعادُ». Read the lines aloud slowly, then choose a poem you like, memorise part of it and recite it to your friends.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum shayri parhna seekhte hain. Nazm Kab bin Zuhair ka mashhoor qaseeda «بانَتْ سُعادُ» hai. Ashaar aahista aawaz se parhein, phir apni pasand ki nazm ka hissa yaad karke doston ko sunayein.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى إِنْشادِ الشِّعْرِ، وَالقَصيدَةُ هِيَ قَصيدَةُ كَعْبِ بْنِ زُهَيْرٍ المَشْهورَةُ «بانَتْ سُعادُ». اقْرَأِ الأَبْياتَ بِصَوْتٍ عالٍ وَبِبُطْءٍ، ثُمَّ اخْتَرْ قَصيدَةً تُحِبُّها وَاحْفَظْ جُزْءاً مِنْها وَأَنْشِدْهُ أَمامَ أَصْدِقائِكَ.

dialogue.ar: بانَتْ سُعادُ، فَقَلْبي اليَوْمَ مَتْبولُ.
dialogue.tr: bānat Suʿādu, fa-qalbī l-yawma matbūl
dialogue.en: Suʿād has gone far away, and my heart today is sick with love.
dialogue.ur: Suaad door chali gayi, aur aaj mera dil ishq mein bimar hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما سُعادُ غَداةَ البَيْنِ إِذْ رَحَلوا إِلّا أَغَنُّ غَضيضُ الطَّرْفِ مَكْحولُ.
dialogue.tr: wa mā Suʿādu ghadāta l-bayni idh raḥalū illā aghannu ghaḍīḍu ṭ-ṭarfi makḥūl
dialogue.en: On the morning of parting, when they left, Suʿād was only a soft-voiced one with lowered, kohl-lined eyes.
dialogue.ur: Judai ki subah jab woh rawana hue to Suaad narm aawaz, jhuki nazar aur surme wali aankhon wali thi.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الرَّسولَ لَنورٌ يُسْتَضاءُ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: inna r-rasūla la-nūrun yustaḍāʾu bih
dialogue.en: Indeed the Messenger is a light by which one is guided.
dialogue.ur: Beshak Rasool ek noor hain jis se roshni li jaati hai.

dialogue.ar: مُهَنَّدٌ مِنْ سُيوفِ اللهِ مَسْلولُ.
dialogue.tr: muhannadun min suyūfi llāhi maslūl
dialogue.en: A drawn Indian sword from the swords of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki talwaron mein se ek khinchi hui talwar.

dialogue.ar: وَالعَفْوُ عِنْدَ رَسولِ اللهِ مَأْمولُ.
dialogue.tr: wal-ʿafwu ʿinda rasūli llāhi maʾmūl
dialogue.en: And pardon is hoped for from the Messenger of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah ke Rasool se maafi ki umeed hai.

options_ar: كَلامٌ مَوْزونٌ مُقَفًّى يَتَأَلَّفُ مِنْ أَبْياتٍ

q.en: In the poem, the Messenger is described as:
q.ur: Nazm mein Rasool ko kya kaha gaya?

title.en: Grammar (B): Nouns in the accusative case (manṣūbāt)

intro.en: Some nouns take the 'opened' ending (fatḥa ـَ). They include: the object (مفعول به), the absolute object, the object of purpose, the time/place adverb, the name of إنّ, the predicate of كان, the exception, the state (ḥāl), the specification (tamyīz) and a follower of a manṣūb. Example: «سِرْتُ والقَمَرَ» - 'I walked with the moon'.
intro.ur: Kuch ismon par nasb (فتحہ) aata hai: maf'ool bihi, maf'ool mutlaq, maf'ool li-ajlihi, zarf, ism-e-inna, khabar-e-kaana, mustasna, haal, tamyeez aur mansub ka tabe'. Misaal: «سِرْتُ والقَمَرَ» - 'main chand ke saath chala'.
intro.ar: بَعْضُ الأَسْماءِ تَأْتي مَنْصوبَةً بِالفَتْحَةِ، مِنْها: المَفْعولُ بِهِ، وَالمَفْعولُ المُطْلَقُ، وَالمَفْعولُ لِأَجْلِهِ، وَظَرْفا الزَّمانِ وَالمَكانِ، وَاسْمُ إِنَّ، وَخَبَرُ كانَ، وَالمُسْتَثْنى، وَالحالُ، وَالتَّمْييزُ، وَالتّابِعُ لِمَنْصوبٍ. مِثالٌ: «سِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ».

dialogue.ar: لِيَجْزِيَ اللهُ الصّادِقينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: li-yajziya llāhu ṣ-ṣādiqīna bi-ṣidqihim
dialogue.en: So that Allah rewards the truthful for their truthfulness. (ṣādiqīn = object)
dialogue.ur: Taake Allah sachchon ko unke sach ka badla de. (sadiqeen = maf'ool bihi)

dialogue.ar: إِنّا فَتَحْنا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبينًا.
dialogue.tr: innā fataḥnā laka fatḥan mubīnā
dialogue.en: We have given you a clear victory. (fatḥan = absolute object)
dialogue.ur: Humne aap ko khuli fatah di. (fathan = maf'ool mutlaq)

dialogue.ar: وَادْعوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا.
dialogue.tr: wadʿūhu khawfan wa ṭamaʿā
dialogue.en: And call upon Him in fear and hope. (object of purpose)
dialogue.ur: Aur usay khauf aur ummeed se pukaro. (maf'ool li-ajlihi)

dialogue.ar: سِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ.
dialogue.tr: sirtu wal-qamara
dialogue.en: I walked along with the moon. (object of accompaniment)
dialogue.ur: Main chand ke saath chala. (maf'ool ma'ahu)

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ اللهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna llāhu ghafūran raḥīmā
dialogue.en: And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful. (ghafūran = predicate of kāna)
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah bakhshne wala meherban hai. (ghafooran = khabar-e-kaana)

dialogue.ar: قالَتا أَتَيْنا طائِعينَ.
dialogue.tr: qālatā atayna ṭāʾiʿīn
dialogue.en: The two said: we have come willingly. (ṭāʾiʿīn = state)
dialogue.ur: Dono ne kaha: hum farmanbardari se aaye. (taa'ieen = haal)

dialogue.ar: فَلَبِثَ فيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلّا خَمْسينَ عامًا.
dialogue.tr: fa-labitha fīhim alfa sanatin illā khamsīna ʿāmā
dialogue.en: He stayed among them a thousand years less fifty years. (exception)
dialogue.ur: Woh unmein hazaar saal rahe siwaye pachas saal ke. (mustasna)

dialogue.ar: فَتَحَ قَلْبَهُ لِأَخيهِ.
dialogue.tr: fataḥa qalbahu li-akhīhi
dialogue.en: He opened his heart to his brother.
dialogue.ur: Usne apne bhai ke liye apna dil khol diya.

dialogue.ar: سَعيدٌ أَقْوى قَلْبًا مِنْ أَخيهِ.
dialogue.tr: saʿīdun aqwā qalban min akhīhi
dialogue.en: Saeed is stronger in heart than his brother. (qalban = specification)
dialogue.ur: Saeed apne bhai se dil mein zyada mazboot hai. (qalban = tamyeez)

options_ar: العُضْوُ الَّذي يَضُخُّ الدَّمَ في الجِسْمِ

q.en: In «سِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ», the word «القَمَرَ» ends with fatḥa because it is:
q.ur: «سِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ» mein «القَمَرَ» par fatha kyun hai?
q.ar: في «سِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ» جاءَتْ «القَمَرَ» مَنْصوبَةً بِالفَتْحَةِ لِأَنَّها:

q.ur: Mansub ism aam taur par kis par khatam hote hain?

q.en: In «إِلّا خَمْسينَ عامًا», the word after «إِلّا» is called:
q.ur: «إِلّا» ke baad aane wale lafz ko kya kehte hain?
q.ar: في «إِلّا خَمْسينَ عاماً» تُسَمّى الكَلِمَةُ بَعْدَ «إِلّا»:

intro.en: A story about a poor fisherman who is truly content. The writer meets him and asks how a man can be happy while poor. The fisherman gives wise answers about happiness, trust in Allah and fate. Read each paragraph, then answer the questions.
intro.ur: Ek ghareeb machhere ki kahani jo dil se mutmaeen hai. Musannif uss se milta hai aur poochta hai ke ghareeb aadmi khush kaise reh sakta hai. Machhera khushi, Allah par bharosay aur taqdeer ke bare mein dana jawab deta hai. Har paragraph parhein aur sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ عَنْ صَيّادٍ فَقيرٍ راضٍ بِحالِهِ حَقّاً. يَلْقاهُ الكاتِبُ وَيَسْأَلُهُ: كَيْفَ يَكونُ الإِنْسانُ سَعيداً وَهُوَ فَقيرٌ؟ فَيُجيبُهُ الصَّيّادُ بِأَجْوِبَةٍ حَكيمَةٍ عَنِ السَّعادَةِ وَالتَّوَكُّلِ عَلى اللهِ وَالقَدَرِ. اقْرَأْ كُلَّ فِقْرَةٍ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

dialogue.ar: لا أَذْكُرُ أَنّي بِتُّ لَيْلَةً في حَياتي جائِعًا.
dialogue.tr: lā adhkuru annī bittu laylatan fī ḥayātī jāʾiʿā
dialogue.en: I do not remember spending a night hungry in my life.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe yaad nahin ke meri zindagi mein kabhi bhooka raat guzari ho.

dialogue.ar: حَسْبي أَنْ أَحْمِلَ شَبَكَتي كُلَّ مَطْلَعِ فَجْرٍ، وَأَذْهَبَ بِها إِلى شاطِئِ النَّهْرِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥasbī an aḥmila shabakatī kulla maṭlaʿi fajr, wa adhhaba bihā ilā shāṭiʾi n-nahr
dialogue.en: It is enough for me to carry my net every dawn and go with it to the river bank.
dialogue.ur: Mere liye kafi hai ke har fajr apna jaal uthaun aur nadi ke kinare chala jaun.

dialogue.ar: فَإِذا أَخَذْتُ مِنَ السَّمَكِ كَفافَ يَوْمي عُدْتُ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-idhā akhadhtu mina s-samaki kafāfa yawmī ʿudtu bih
dialogue.en: When I have taken enough fish for my day, I go back with it.
dialogue.ur: Jab main apne din bhar ka kafi machhli le leta hun to lautt aata hun.

dialogue.ar: نِمْتُ في فِراشي نَوْمَةً هادِئَةً مُطْمَئِنَّةً.
dialogue.tr: nimtu fī firāshī nawmatan hādiʾatan muṭmaʾinna
dialogue.en: I sleep in my bed a calm, peaceful sleep.
dialogue.ur: Main apne bistar par pur-sukoon neend sota hun.

dialogue.ar: فَأَنا أَعْبُدُهُ حَقَّ عِبادَتِهِ، وَأُخْلِصُ في تَوْحيدِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-ana aʿbuduhu ḥaqqa ʿibādatih, wa ukhliṣu fī tawḥīdih
dialogue.en: I worship Him as He deserves to be worshipped, and I am sincere in His oneness.
dialogue.ur: Main uski ibadat ka haq ada karta hun aur uski tawheed mein mukhlis hun.

dialogue.ar: آمَنْتُ بِالقَضاءِ وَالقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ.
dialogue.tr: āmantu bil-qaḍāʾi wal-qadari khayrihi wa sharrih
dialogue.en: I believe in the divine decree and fate, its good and its bad.
dialogue.ur: Main qaza o qadar par imaan rakhta hun, uski khair par bhi aur shar par bhi.

dialogue.ar: ما العالَمُ إِلّا بَحْرٌ زاخِرٌ، وَما النّاسُ إِلّا أَسْماكُهُ المائِجَةُ فيهِ.
dialogue.tr: mā l-ʿālamu illā baḥrun zākhir, wa mā n-nāsu illā asmākuhu l-māʾijatu fīh
dialogue.en: The world is only a surging sea, and people are only its fish moving in it.
dialogue.ur: Dunya bas ek thathein marta samundar hai aur log us mein tairti machhliyan hain.

dialogue.ar: يا شَيْخُ، إِنَّ النّاسَ جَميعًا يَبْكونَ عَلى السَّعادَةِ، فَكَيْفَ تَعُدُّ العالَمَ سَعيدًا؟
dialogue.tr: yā shaykh, inna n-nāsa jamīʿan yabkūna ʿalā s-saʿāda, fa-kayfa taʿuddu l-ʿālama saʿīdā?
dialogue.en: O sheikh, all people cry for happiness, so how do you count the world happy?
dialogue.ur: Shaikh sahib, sab log khushi ko tarastay hain, to aap dunya ko khush kaise ginte hain?

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الإِنْسانَ سَعيدٌ بِفِطْرَتِهِ، وَإِنَّما هُوَ الَّذي يَجْلُبُ بِنَفْسِهِ الشَّقاءَ إِلى نَفْسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: inna l-insāna saʿīdun bi-fiṭratih, wa innamā huwa lladhī yajlibu bi-nafsihi sh-shaqāʾa ilā nafsih
dialogue.en: Man is happy by his nature; it is he who brings misery upon himself.
dialogue.ur: Insan apni fitrat mein khush hai, woh khud hi apne liye bad-bakhti kheench laata hai.

dialogue.ar: مَنْ أَرادَ أَنْ يَطْلُبَ السَّعادَةَ فَلْيَطْلُبْها بَيْنَ جَوانِبِ النَّفْسِ الفاضِلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: man arāda an yaṭluba s-saʿādata falyaṭlubhā bayna jawānibi n-nafsi l-fāḍila
dialogue.en: Whoever wants to seek happiness, let him seek it within a virtuous soul.
dialogue.ur: Jo khushi talash karna chahe woh use nek nafs ke andar talash kare.

dialogue.ar: أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ اللهَ يا سَيِّدي، وَالسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: astawdiʿuka llāha yā sayyidī, was-salāmu ʿalayka wa raḥmatu llāh
dialogue.en: I leave you in Allah's care, my master. Peace and Allah's mercy be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Aey mere sardar, main aap ko Allah ke supurd karta hun. Aap par salamati aur Allah ki rehmat ho.

q.en: In the story, where does the fisherman go every dawn?
q.ur: Kahani mein machhera har fajr kahan jata hai?
q.ar: إِلى أَيْنَ يَذْهَبُ الصَّيّادُ كُلَّ فَجْرٍ في القِصَّةِ؟

options: to the river bank / nadi ke kinare

q.en: According to the fisherman, where should happiness be sought?
q.ur: Machhere ke mutabiq khushi kahan talash karni chahiye?
q.ar: أَيْنَ يَجِبُ أَنْ نَطْلُبَ السَّعادَةَ بِحَسَبِ الصَّيّادِ؟

options: within a virtuous soul / nek nafs ke andar
in wealth only / sirf daulat mein
the envious person / hasad karne wala
options_ar: الَّذي يَتَمَنّى زَوالَ النِّعْمَةِ عَنْ غَيْرِهِ

q.ur: Machhera aakhir mein kya kehta hai?

options: Peace and Allah's mercy be upon you
